items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to actually render the view.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法才能实际渲染视图。

items.source: response - current HTTP response
items.translation: response - 当前 HTTP 响应

items.source: Currently needed for Spring's FreeMarker default macros. Note that this is not required for templates that use HTML forms unless you wish to take advantage of the Spring helper macros.
items.translation: 当前需要用于 Spring 的 FreeMarker 默认宏。请注意，对于使用 HTML 表单的模板，并非必需，除非您希望利用 Spring 辅助宏。

items.source:
JSP/JSTL and other view technologies automatically have access to the
HttpServletRequest object and thereby the request/session attributes
for the current user. Furthermore, they are able to create and cache
helper objects as request attributes themselves.
items.translation: JSP/JSTL 及其他视图技术自动拥有对 HttpServletRequest 对象的访问权限，从而可以获取当前用户的请求/会话属性。此外，它们还能够自行创建并缓存辅助对象作为请求属性。

items.source:
Note that some templates may make request attributes visible
on their own, for example, FreeMarker, without exposure in the MVC model.
items.translation: 请注意，某些模板（例如 FreeMarker）可能会自行暴露请求属性，而无需在 MVC 模型中进行显式暴露。

items.source:
Only applies the view's contentType if no content type has been
set on the response before. This allows handlers to override the
default content type beforehand.
items.translation: 仅当响应之前未设置内容类型时，才应用视图的 contentType。这允许处理程序在默认内容类型之前进行覆盖。

items.source:
Variable name of the RequestContext instance in the template model,
available to Spring's macros: for example, for creating BindStatus objects.
items.translation: 模板模型中 RequestContext 实例的变量名，可供 Spring 宏使用：例如用于创建 BindStatus 对象。

items.source:
Set whether HttpServletRequest attributes are allowed to override (hide)
controller generated model attributes of the same name. Default is "false"
which causes an exception to be thrown if request attributes of the same
name as model attributes are found.
items.translation: 设置是否允许 `HttpServletRequest` 属性覆盖（隐藏）同名的控制器生成的模型属性。默认值为 `"false"`，如果找到与模型属性同名请求属性，将抛出异常。

items.source:
Set whether all HttpSession attributes should be added to the
model prior to merging with the template. Default is "false".
items.translation: 设置是否应在与模板合并之前将所有 HttpSession 属性添加到模型中。默认值为"false"。

items.source:
Set whether HttpSession attributes are allowed to override (hide)
controller generated model attributes of the same name. Default is "false",
which causes an exception to be thrown if session attributes of the same
name as model attributes are found.
items.translation: 设置是否允许 HttpSession 属性覆盖（隐藏）同名的控制器生成的模型属性。默认值为"false"，如果找到与模型属性同名与会话属性，将抛出异常。

items.source: Exception - if rendering failed
items.translation: Exception - 如果渲染失败

items.source: request - current HTTP request
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求

items.source: model - combined output Map, with request attributes and session attributes merged into it if required
items.translation: model - 合并输出 Map，如果需要，会将请求属性和会话属性合并到其中。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Darren Davison
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Darren Davison

items.source:
The first step will be preparing the request: In the JSP case,
this would mean setting model objects as request attributes.
The second step will be the actual rendering of the view,
for example including the JSP via a RequestDispatcher.
items.translation: 第一步是准备请求：在 JSP 的情况下，这意味着将模型对象设置为请求属性。第二步是视图的实际渲染，例如通过 RequestDispatcher 包含 JSP。

items.source: Description copied from class: AbstractView
items.translation: 描述从类复制：AbstractView

items.source:
Apply this view's content type as specified in the "contentType"
bean property to the given response.
items.translation: 将此视图的内容类型（如"contentType"bean 属性中指定）应用到给定的响应。

items.source:
Set whether HttpServletRequest attributes are allowed to override (hide)
controller generated model attributes of the same name.
items.translation: 设置是否允许 HttpServletRequest 属性覆盖（隐藏）同名的控制器生成的模型属性。

items.source:
Set whether HttpSession attributes are allowed to override (hide)
controller generated model attributes of the same name.
items.translation: 设置是否允许 HttpSession 属性覆盖（隐藏）同名的控制器生成的模型属性。

items.source:
Set whether all request attributes should be added to the
model prior to merging with the template.
items.translation: 设置是否应在与模板合并之前将所有请求属性添加到模型中。

items.source:
Set whether all HttpSession attributes should be added to the
model prior to merging with the template.
items.translation: 设置是否应在与模板合并之前，将所有 HttpSession 属性添加到模型中。

items.source:
Set whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library,
under the name "springMacroRequestContext".
items.translation: 设置是否暴露一个 RequestContext 供 Spring 的宏库使用，名称为"springMacroRequestContext"。

items.source: renderMergedOutputModel in class AbstractView
items.translation: `renderMergedOutputModel` 在类 `AbstractView` 中

items.source: model - combined output Map (never null), with dynamic values taking precedence over static attributes
items.translation: model - 组合输出 Map（永不null），动态值优先于静态属性。
